Sum of all but one angle is 1070°. The full sum (n−2)·180 = 1070 + x, with 0 < x < 180.

So 1070 < (n−2)·180 < 1250. Dividing by 180: 5.94 < n−2 < 6.94, so n−2 = 6, giving n = 8. Check: 1080 − 1070 = 10°, valid.

Solution A incorrectly set up the equation and then picked n = 9, which would give a sum of 1260 and an angle of 190°, not possible in a convex polygon. Solution B reached 8, though its reasoning only used the upper bound and was somewhat sloppy, but the answer is correct.

WINNER: B
